storage.scan:
# Lion storage scan v1
uid=$(id -u) || exit 1
case "$uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1 ;; esac
printf 'LION_STORAGE_V1\t%s\n' "$uid"
printf 'HOME\t'
{ find -H '/home/tester' -xdev -mindepth 1 -uid "$uid" -printf 'ENTRY\t%D\t%i\t%b\t%y\n'; printf 'EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"; } | awk -F '\t' '
$1 == "ENTRY" { if (!seen[$2 ":" $3]++) bytes += $4 * 512; entries++; if ($5 == "f" || $5 == "l") candidates++ }
$1 == "EXIT" { code = $2; finished = 1 }
END { printf "%.0f\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", bytes, entries, candidates, finished ? code : 99 }'
printf 'TMP\t'
{ find -P '/tmp' -xdev -mindepth 1 \( -type d ! -uid "$uid" \( ! -readable -o ! -executable \) -prune \) -o \( -uid "$uid" -printf 'ENTRY\t%D\t%i\t%b\t%y\n' \); printf 'EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"; } | awk -F '\t' '
$1 == "ENTRY" { if (!seen[$2 ":" $3]++) bytes += $4 * 512; entries++; if ($5 == "f" || $5 == "l") candidates++ }
$1 == "EXIT" { code = $2; finished = 1 }
END { printf "%.0f\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", bytes, entries, candidates, finished ? code : 99 }'
storage.preview:
# Lion tmp preview v1
uid=$(id -u) || exit 1
case "$uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -L /tmp ] || [ ! -d /tmp ]; then printf '临时目录不是可安全清理的实际目录\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'LION_TMP_PREVIEW_V1\t%s\n' "$uid"
printf 'TMP\t'
{ find -P '/tmp' -xdev -mindepth 1 \( -type d ! -uid "$uid" \( ! -readable -o ! -executable \) -prune \) -o \( -uid "$uid" -printf 'ENTRY\t%D\t%i\t%b\t%y\n' \); printf 'EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"; } | awk -F '\t' '
$1 == "ENTRY" { if (!seen[$2 ":" $3]++) bytes += $4 * 512; entries++; if ($5 == "f" || $5 == "l") candidates++ }
$1 == "EXIT" { code = $2; finished = 1 }
END { printf "%.0f\t%d\t%d\t%d\n", bytes, entries, candidates, finished ? code : 99 }'
storage.cleanup1000:
# Lion tmp cleanup v1
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
export PATH
uid=$(id -u) || exit 1
case "$uid" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1 ;; esac
if [ "$uid" != '1000' ] || [ "$uid" = 0 ]; then printf '用户 UID 已变化或禁止清理 root 临时文件\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -L /tmp ] || [ ! -d /tmp ]; then printf '临时目录不是可安全清理的实际目录\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf 'LION_TMP_CLEANUP_V1\t%s\n' "$uid"
total=0
result=$({ find -P /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \( -type d ! -uid "$uid" \( ! -readable -o ! -executable \) -prune \) -o \( -uid "$uid" \( -type f -o -type l \) -execdir /bin/sh -c 'uid="$1"; shift
find -P "$@" -maxdepth 0 -uid "$uid" \( -type f -o -type l \) -delete -printf '"'"'DELETED\n'"'"'' lion-tmp "$uid" {} + -prune \); printf 'EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"; } | awk -F '\t' '
$1 == "DELETED" { count++ }
$1 == "EXIT" { code = $2; finished = 1 }
END { printf "%d %d\n", count, finished ? code : 99 }')
case "$result" in ''|*[!0-9' ']*) exit 1 ;; esac
set -- $result
if [ "$#" != 2 ]; then exit 1; fi
total=$1
status=$2
round=0
if [ "$status" = 0 ]; then
  while [ "$round" -lt 128 ]; do
    round=$((round + 1))
    if [ -L /tmp ] || [ ! -d /tmp ]; then status=1; break; fi
    result=$({ find -P /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \( -type d ! -uid "$uid" \( ! -readable -o ! -executable \) -prune \) -o \( -uid "$uid" -type d -empty -execdir /bin/sh -c 'uid="$1"; shift
find -P "$@" -maxdepth 0 -uid "$uid" -type d -empty -delete -printf '"'"'DELETED\n'"'"'' lion-tmp "$uid" {} + -prune \); printf 'EXIT\t%s\n' "$?"; } | awk -F '\t' '
$1 == "DELETED" { count++ }
$1 == "EXIT" { code = $2; finished = 1 }
END { printf "%d %d\n", count, finished ? code : 99 }')
    case "$result" in ''|*[!0-9' ']*) exit 1 ;; esac
    set -- $result
    if [ "$#" != 2 ]; then exit 1; fi
    total=$((total + $1))
    status=$2
    if [ "$status" != 0 ] || [ "$1" = 0 ]; then break; fi
    if [ "$round" = 128 ]; then status=2; fi
  done
fi
printf 'RESULT\t%s\t%s\n' "$total" "$status"
